{{Top|leg}}
An '''osi''' was the title given to the leader of a [[Krikthasi]] [[junieuw]], The osi was usually the most powerful warrior in the territory. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Osi [[Hass]] led the [[Undrarian]] junieuw.
